heading: Repealed. Aug. 1, 1956, ch. 837, title V, § 502(7), 70 Stat. 886

notes.text: Section, acts Jan. 19, 1942, ch. 6, § 9, 56 Stat. 8; Mar. 29, 1944, ch. 141, § 4, 58 Stat. 130; July 15, 1954, ch. 507, § 15, 68 Stat. 481, provided for payment of death gratuity to survivors of commissioned officers of Coast and Geodetic Survey.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective Jan. 1, 1957, see section 603(a) of act Aug. 1, 1956.
